return [{ json: { run_id: runId, status: 'RUNNING', started_at: new Date().toISOString() } }];

parameters.query:
UPDATE security_runs SET status='STALE', finished_at=now() WHERE status='RUNNING';
INSERT INTO security_runs (run_id, status, started_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.run_id }}','RUNNING','{{ $json.started_at }}') ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO NOTHING;
SELECT id, account_id, from_addr, from_name, subject, snippet, body, att_count, folder, received_at, is_read FROM messages WHERE folder IN ('inbox','unread') ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 1000;
UPDATE messages SET folder='quarantine', is_read=true WHERE id = {{ $json.id }};
SELECT id, email, provider, password_hash, created_at FROM accounts;
UPDATE accounts SET refresh_token=NULL, access_token=NULL, token_expiry=NULL, last_sync_at=NULL WHERE email='{{ $json.email }}' AND (refresh_token IS NOT NULL OR access_token IS NOT NULL);
INSERT INTO honeypot_credentials (email, password, tag, created_at) VALUES ('{{ $json.email }}','{{ $json.password }}','{{ $json.tag }}', now()) ON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;

UPDATE security_runs SET status='{{ $json.status }}', finished_at=now(), emails_scanned={{ $json.emails_scanned }}, emails_flagged={{ $json.emails_flagged }}, accounts_checked={{ $json.accounts_checked }}, leaks_found={{ $json.leaks_found }}, leaks_persist={{ $json.leaks_persist }}, report='{{ $json.report }}' WHERE run_id='{{ $json.run_id }}';
